page.chooseAFolderForThis: Choose a folder for this subscription
page.reviewEpisodeLeaveEmptyFor: review, episode — leave empty for everything
page.pasteAChannelPlaylistOr: Paste a channel, playlist, or RSS feed URL to subscribe
page.subscribeToAChannelOr: Subscribe to a channel or playlist and Prism will check it periodically, queueing anything new.

optionsNote: These apply to new videos. Keywords match the title and the link, ignoring case. A video they turn down is still remembered, so changing them later won't pull in the back catalogue.
unreadable: Could not read this URL as a channel, playlist, or feed
onlyNew: Only videos published after you subscribe are downloaded — the existing catalog is marked as seen.
